text: Pucca Fort Boundary Wall Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Pucca Fort Boundary Wall Type: Monument - Fort Province: Sindh District: Hyderabad Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 18th-19th Century CE Description: The crest of the fortification wall of Talpur period is decorated with ornamental Kanguras or merlons of very curious shape. In one corner of the Fort, there is a memorial to the native of soldiers who had bravely faced the British attack on the fort in 1843 CE. The monument belongs to Kalhora/Talpur period of Historic Sindh.
